The '''Jewel of Yavin''' was an artifact that was stolen during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[Bialar Selis]], an officer of the [[Bespin Wing Guard/Legends|Bespin Wing Guard]], led the investigation to find the stolen item.
